image_description: A close-up, shallow depth-of-field photograph of several fresh figs. Some are whole, showing dark purple/brown skin, while others are sliced in half or quarters, revealing the characteristic pinkish-red interior flesh and tiny seeds. The lighting is soft, highlighting the texture of the fruit.

To analyze the subtle moisture highlights and seed distribution for any signs of AI smearing or unnatural repetition.
To ensure clean separation between the fruit skins and the blurred background, checking for edge bleeding.
